notes: Taḥwīl: the first branch meets the second at al-Walid (ح); the names the text writes once after him (the unnamed man, Abu Yahya, Abu Hurayra) are the shared tail (rule 3)
«- وسماه الربيع في حديثه عيسى بن عبد الأعلى بن أبي فروة -» is an editor's gloss giving Rabi's version of the unnamed man: not read as a route; the man stays unnamed here (rule 8)
